name: Mesa Prime
description: Cast a long shadow with this lethal enforcer. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
passiveDescription: Shoot dual-wielded sidearms |SPEED|% faster and reload single-handed sidearms |RELOAD|% more rapidly. Gain |HEALTH| Bonus Health when not using Melee Weapons.

abilities.description: When activated, this power stores damage caused by guns. When triggered again, that damage is channelled through the next gunshot.
Gives an ally Extra Damage while jamming the guns of nearby enemies. This power shifts between team members.
Envelops Mesa in a barrier of energy, reflecting back incoming bullet damage.
With intense focus, Mesa draws her Regulator pistols, shooting down her foes in rapid succession.
